git_metadata_source.candidate_pool: 32 PRs merged to main whose titles mark a fix: 2026-07: 2, 2026-08: 7, 2026-09: 10, 2026-10: 13
git_metadata_source.persisted: Repository, commit, path and symbol identifiers and hashes only. No source bodies, diffs or raw tool output (B1).

cutoff_rule.per_case_cutoff: The first parent of the fix's merge commit. Candidate evidence is limited to that tree.
cutoff_rule.expected_locations: The paths and symbols the fix changes. They are withheld labels, never context shown to the candidate.
cutoff_rule.upper_bound: Every case cutoff precedes the snapshot commit and this branch, so a candidate working at a cutoff tree cannot see these fixtures.
cutoff_rule.grouping: Fixes that share an issue, or a fix and its follow-up PR, stay in one split.
cutoff_rule.unavailable_source: A case whose source is unavailable is reported as such, never filled with later code.

split.unit: family groups for the lifecycle trajectories; chronological blocks for localization
split.lifecycle_rationale: Related families never cross a split. Each held-out group has a sibling of the same kind outside it: B against C (origin), E against D (scope and trust), I1 against I2 (recovery).
split.localization_assignment: 12 seeds ordered by cutoff date: the earliest 4 train, the next 4 development, the latest 4 held out.
split.accounting_assignment: Synthetic accounting cases are train and development only. Their oracles are deterministic arithmetic and labels, so withholding them adds no tuning protection.
split.status: Draft by Claude. Codex verifies it at Checkpoint 1; the operator approves held-out content by sampled review under Q29. A change after that approval is versioned with its reason.

label_access.store: All gold, including held-out, is versioned in the repository under tests/fixtures/plan12_memory. It is synthetic content or pointers only.
label_access.readers: Anyone with repository access, including the implementing agent.
label_access.limitation: Claude drafts these cases and is the planned implementer of M1 and M3, so this held-out split guards against fixture tuning inside this plan only. The #248 acceptance campaign needs a fresh sealed held-out set that the implementer has not seen, as the Plan 12.4 pilot's round 2 used a fresh sealed split.
